description: incremental-validity audit tool for reliability detectors
baseline_candidates: spline (cubic B-spline, 5 quantile knots, numeric cols with >=6 values; one-hot categories; logistic)
gbm (HistGradientBoosting: 150 iters, lr 0.05, depth 3, min leaf 20, l2 1.0)
intercept_only: used automatically when no baseline columns are given
headline_rule: family with highest mean out-of-fold baseline-only AUROC over CV seeds; detector not used

permutation.null: conditional randomisation: S* = OOF E[S | baselines] (HistGradientBoostingRegressor, 200 iters, lr 0.05, depth 3) + group-permuted residuals
permutation.p: (1 + #null >= observed) / (1 + B), observed and null at CV seed 0
